book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn LUK

content: Sises Tepin Malipe Sapwellime Tohnpadahk ko
Rahn ehu Sises ketiket ni oaroahr en Lehen Kenesaret, a aramas ngeder ahpw pokondohng reh pwe re en iang rong mahsen en Koht.
Ih eri mahsanihada kisin pwoht riakis me peipei ni oaroahr en leho; a soused kei keredihsangehr powe pwe re en kolahng widen ar uhk kan.
Sises eri ketidahng pohn apwoat kisin pwoht ko, weren Saimon, ahpw mahsanihong en kaieilahsang ekis ni oaroahro. Sises eri ketidiong pohn kisin pwohto oh tapihada padahk ong pokono.
Ni sapwellime mahsen eh eralahr, e ahpw mahsanihong Saimon, “Saimon, kumwail kaieilahng mahs kisin pwohto wasa loal, pwe kumwail en sehngkipeseng amwail uhk kan.”
A Saimon sapeng Sises, patohwan, “Maing, se laidier pwohng wasa lao rahnpeseng, ahpw sohte seikat. Eri, soh, ni mwaromwien me se pahn kihdihki at uhk kat.”
Irail eri sehngkipeseng ar uhk ko. Re ahpw kehledi kiden mwahmw, kereniong pwe arail uhk ko en teipeseng.
Irail eri oalehdo iangarail ko me dake pwoht teio pwe re en patodohng sewese irail; irail eri patohwan seido. Re ahpw akeradahng mwahmw ko nan pwoht riapwoato lao dir; irail eri kereniong mwowikihdi.
Ni Saimon Piter eh kilangada soahng pwukat me wiawiher, e ahpw poaridihsang Sises, patohwanohng, “Maing, komw ketiweisang ie, pwe ngehi aramas dipan emen.”
Ih oh ienge ko koaros inenen pwuriamweikihla soangen laid mwomwin wet me re ahpwtehn wiahda.
Pil duwehte iangarail teiko, Seims oh Sohn, nein Sepedi ko. Sises eri mahsanihong Saimon, “Eri, Saimon, ke dehr masak, pwe sang met kohla ke pahn kin laidih aramas.”
Eri, re ahpw nihdadahng wararail pwoht ko nansapw, oh pwilikihdi arail dipwisou kan koaros oh iangala Sises.
Kakehlepen Ohl Tokutok men

Ehu ahnsou Sises ketiket nan kahnimw ehu, wasa me ohl emen kin iang mi ie me diren tokutok. Ni ohlo eh kilangada Sises, e ahpw poaridiong nanpwel mwowe oh patohwanohng, “Maing, ma komw ketin kupwurki, komw kak ketin kamwakeleiehda!”
Sises ketin kapahla limeo powe oh doahke, mahsanih, “Me mwahu! Mwakelekelda.” Eri, ni ahnsowohte tokutoko ahpw kohsang rehn ohlo.
Sises eri mahsanihong, “Ke dehpa ndahng emen met; a kohwei oh kasalehiong pein kowe samworo pwe en kasawihiuk; ke ahpw kihda meirong en kadehdehn omw mwakelekellahr duwen me Moses koasoanedier.”
Eri, rongen Sises ahpw lolohkseli wasa tohto, oh aramas ngeder ahpw kin pokondohng reh pwe re en rong sapwellime mahsen kan oh ale kamwahupen arail soumwahu kan.
E ahpw kin ketila kalapwukala nan sapwtehn kan, wasa e kin loulou ie.
Sises Kakehlahda Ohl Mwoator men

Rahn ehu ni Sises eh ketin wiewia sapwellime padahk, Parisi kei oh sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo kei pil iang mwomwohd kapilpene ih; re pwarodo sang nan kahnimw koaros en Kalili oh Sudia oh pil sang Serusalem. Roson en Kaun-o me dehde mehlel rehn Sises sang ni eh kin ketin kakehlahda me soumwahu kan.
Eri, ohl ekei ahpw leledo; re rowe ohl mwoator men. Irail eri nannanti pwe re en kapedolong ohl mwoatoro nan ihmwo oh pwilikihdi mwohn Sises.
Ni ar sohte kak pwehki koaiten pokono, re doukihda pohn ihmwo oh koupwoarepeseng pwelengen ihmwo, oh kakihredi me mwoatoro nanpwungen aramas ako mwohn silangin Sises.
Ni Sises eh mwahngihada uwen ar pwoson, e ahpw mahsanihong me mwoatoro, “Lao! Dipomw kan lapwasanguhkehr.”
Sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo ko oh Parisi ko ahpw mengimengloalki, “Ihs ohl menet me lahlahwe Koht? Ihs me kak lapwahda dihp? Kaidehk Koht kelehpw?”
Sises ketin mwahngih duwen ar mengimengloal, iei me e ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “Dahme kumwail mengimengloalki?
Dahme mengei rehn nda, ‘Dipomw kan lapwasanguhkehr,’ oh nda, ‘Uhda oh aluwei?”

Eri, pwe kumwail en ese me Nein-Aramas sapwellimaniki manaman en lapwahda dihp nin sampah...” E ahpw ketin sohpeilahng me mwoatoro oh mahsanihong, “Lao, I ndaiong uhk, uhda, ale kihomwen oh kohkohwei ni imwomwo!”
Eri, ni ahnsowohte, me mwoatoro pa uhda mwohrail koaros, ale kiheo me e kin wonohn loale, kohla ni imweo, oh kapikapinga Koht.
Irail koaros ahpw pwuriamweikihla mehlel! Nan ar masak, re ahpw ndinda, “Ia uwen soangen kapwuriamwei kan me se kilangehr rahnwet!”
Sises Malipe Lipai
Mwurin mepwukat Sises ketiketla sang wasao, e ahpw ketin mahsanihada sounrik daksis men, ede Lipai, me mwomwohd nan eh ohpis. Sises eri mahsanihong, “Iangiehla.”
Lipai uhdahte kesehla mehkoaros me e ahneki oh iangala Sises.
Lipai eri wiahiong Sises lapalahn kamadipw ehu ni imweo; sounrik daksis tohto oh aramas mwahl kei pil iang mwohdehng tehpelo.
Parisi kei oh arail sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo kei ahpw lipahnedkihda oh patohwanohng tohnpadahk ko, “Dahme kumwail kin iangki tungoal rehn sounrik daksis oh aramas sekeniken kan?”
Sises ahpw ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “Kaidehkin aramas kehlail kan me kin anahne toakte, pwe me soumwahu kan.
I sohte kodohn ndahng me lelepek kan re en wiliakapwala, pwe me dipan akan.”
Peidek duwen Kaisihsol
Ekei irail ahpw patohwanohng Sises, “Dahme nein Sohn tohnpadahk ko kin kalap kaisihsolki oh kapakapki, pil duwehte nein Parisi tohnpadahk kan, a sapwellimomwi kan ahpw kin tungoal oh nim.”
Sises ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “Ia duwe, kumwail lemeleme me kumwail pahn kak kaisihsolih tohnkapar en kamadipw en kapwopwoud nindokon ohl kamwohdo eh mihmi rehrail? Kumwail sohte kak!
Ahpw ehu ahnsou pahn kohdo me ohl kamwohdo pahn pehdsang irail, eri, ih rahno me re pahn kaisihsol.”

Sises eri mahsanihong irail karasaras pwoatet: “Sohte me kin tehrasang kisehn sekid kapw, e ahpw deipinaiong ni sekid mering; pwe ma e pahn wia met, e kauwelahr sekid kapwo, oh kisehn sekid kapwo sohte pahn pahrekiong sekid meringo.

Pil duwehte, sohte me kin wudekihong wain kapw nan ehd kilin mahn mering; pwe ma e pahn wia met, wain kapwo pahn kahrehiong ehd meringo eh pahn mpwospeseng oh teipeseng, waino ahpw pahn wudekla oh ehdo pahn ohla.
Ahpw aramas kin wudekihong wain kapw nan ehd kapw.
Eri, sohte emen kin nda me e iouki wain kapw mwurin eh songadahr wain mering. Pwe e kin nda, “Me meringo me iou mehlel.”
